items.title: Huntington Bancshares Shares Fall 3% After Bank Lowers Earnings Guidance
items.summary: Huntington Bancshares (NASDAQ:HBAN) shares declined 3% on Monday after the regional bank reduced its fiscal 2027 earnings forecast and revised several elements of its 2026 outlook at the Barclays Global Financial Conference. The company cited higher short-term interest rates and competition in loan and deposit pricing as factors limiting the expected expansion of its net interest margin.
